mostWorthwhile.text: Making the drum was most worthwhile: the explanation of cloth stretched over the jar made the construction clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding air to the hollow tube was the least engaging step; it produced a flute without explaining how the tube became an instrument.

surprise.text: Carving the wood produced a hollow tube rather than a finished flute, so the instrument needed another step.

arbitrary.text: Combining the hollow tube with air to make a flute felt somewhat arbitrary, since the result did not explain the transformation.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the drum's physical explanation was interesting, though the other combinations were fairly predictable.
